findings.explanation: RepsConfigViewSet.get_queryset returns RepsConfig.objects.all() without filtering by the requesting user, unlike every sibling config viewset (WeightConfig, MaxWeightConfig, SetsConfig, RestConfig, MaxRestConfig, RiRConfig) which filter on slot_config__slot__day__routine__user=self.request.user. RepsConfig extends AbstractChangeConfig, which has a slot_config FK and the new get_owner_object() (slot_config.slot.day.routine), so the object is owner-scoped. Because the queryset is unfiltered, a GET /reps-config/ list and a GET /reps-config/<pk>/ detail expose other users' RepsConfig objects (IDOR). The WgerPermission.has_object_permission check (wger/utils/permissions.py:43-58) is bypassed for list retrieval, and the WgerOwnerObjectModelViewSet.create/update ownership check (wger/utils/viewsets.py:30-54) only validates the slot_config passed in request.data, not the object being read. This is a newly exposed endpoint added by the PR (registered in wger/urls.py).

findings.suggested_fix: Filter the queryset by the requesting user, consistent with the sibling viewsets: return RepsConfig.objects.filter(slot_config__slot__day__routine__user=self.request.user).
